message.text: I'm noting that the frontend logic lives in useMemoQueries.ts, which relies on memoServiceClient from connect.ts.

q17.

`web/src/hooks/useMemoQueries.ts`; `memoServiceClient`

This module defines the memo CRUD queries/mutations (`useMemos`, `useInfiniteMemos`, `useMemo`, create/update/delete mutations, etc.) using React Query, and calls them via the `memoServiceClient` (imported from `web/src/connect.ts`, defined at line 197 as `createClient(MemoService, transport)`).
